steps.title: Welcome to the Red Team Simulator
steps.content: This agent acts as an automated adversary, continually testing your defenses by simulating sophisticated, multi-stage cyberattacks.

steps.title: Vulnerability Chaining
steps.content: Unlike standard scanners that report isolated bugs, the Red Team Agent chains low-severity issues together to demonstrate high-impact compromises.

steps.title: Lateral Movement & Pivot
steps.content: Watch the agent attempt to move laterally across your network, escalating privileges and seeking out high-value assets just like a real Advanced Persistent Threat (APT).

steps.title: Explore the Arsenal
steps.content: Check out the Tools View to see the offensive security arsenal the agent employs, from Nmap and Amass to Metasploit and BloodHound.

steps.title: Defense Validation
steps.content: Use the resulting Attack Paths to validate your defensive posture and ensure your SIEM and EDR solutions are properly tuned to detect these behaviors.
